summary: Iter 177 — Payroll DA + Attendance Bonus + Enhanced Bulk Salary Breakup Upload tested end-to-end. Backend: 17 pytest cases (16 pass / 1 fail) covering bulk template header (DA + Attendance Bonus cols, 51 prefilled rows), /master/bulk/validate dry-run (counts, per-row action, da/gross/attendance_bonus display, changed_fields, verified ZERO DB writes), /master/bulk/import upsert (no duplicates created on repeated import, error rows for bad number / unknown code / bonus Y with amount 0 not written), PUT /master/{id} persistence of da+bonus, payroll run preview (da present & prorated by paid_days/total_days, Attendance Bonus paid only when lop_days=0, legacy masters without DA get no 'da' key), payslip PDF label mapping 'DA (Dearness Allowance)' + 'Attendance Bonus', payslip list + single payslip PDF regression, HR4 salary-structure create+approve syncing da/attendance_bonus into payroll_master. Frontend: verified Payroll Master DA column, + Add dialog (master-da, master-att-bonus-flag, master-att-bonus-amount disabled until ticked), Template button, Bulk Upload → validation preview dialog (counts tiles + per-row UPDATE/ERROR rows + changed field 'da') → Confirm Update → import result dialog, Cancel closes without importing, HrPhase4 New Structure dialog (ss-da, ss-att-bonus-flag/amount), Monthly Run preview (16 slips, slip dialog shows 'DA (Dearness Allowance)'), Payslips tab with All PDF + Email All. Only failure is a pre-existing DB data-integrity issue (duplicate payroll_master docs) — NOT caused by the new bulk import (verified: re-import returned created=0 and doc count unchanged).

minor.issue: 5 employee_ids have 2 payroll_master docs each (36d17794…, 33703dfb…, f404e271…, f88314ab…, 59dfad8a… — all 'PYTEST HR4 Emp' test employees). One doc of each pair was written by hr_phase4 approve `update_one(..., upsert=True)` WITHOUT `id`/`created_at`; the other by the bulk upload. Consequence: GET /payroll/master returns duplicate rows, PUT/import update_one touches only one doc (stale twin), UI shows duplicate rows + React duplicate/undefined key warning. Fix: dedupe collection, add $setOnInsert {id, created_at} in hr_phase4 upsert, and add a unique index on payroll_master.employee_id.
No delete/void endpoint, so QA/test structures accumulate (4 leftover SS rows from repeated test runs were removed manually via DB). Consider a void/cancel endpoint.

rca_of_the_issue: Duplicate payroll_master documents: hr_phase4_router.approve_structure uses update_one(..., upsert=True) with only $set fields, so upserted docs lack `id`/`created_at`. There is no unique index on payroll_master.employee_id, so any code path (or an older build of the bulk importer, which stamped these twins on 2026-08-24 09:05) can insert a second doc for the same employee. Current bulk import code is correct (existing-row detection + update_one), reproduced with an import for one of the affected employees: doc count stayed at 2, created=0. Impact: duplicate rows in the Payroll Master UI, React key warning, and risk of payslips reading a stale twin.
